pr_title: Add CTX copy function for EVP_MD to optimize the performance of EVP_MD_CTX_copy_ex
pr_body:
1. Add OSSL_FUNC_digest_copyctx_fn function for EVP_MD, which is used to copy algctx from the old EVP_MD_CTX to the new one.

2. Add implementation of OSSL_FUNC_digest_copyctx_fn function for default providers.

3. Modify EVP_MD_CTX_copy_ex: When the fetched digest is the same in in and out contexts, use the copy function to copy the members in EVP_MD_CTX if the OSSL_FUNC_digest_copyctx_fn function exists. Otherwise, use the previous method to copy.

4. Add documentation for OSSL_FUNC_digest_copyctx function in doc/man7/provider-digest.pod.

5. Add testcase.

Fixes #25703

issue_context.title: Performance optimization of pbkdf2_derive
comments: There is actually already a special case for when the fetched digest is the same in in and out contexts so we at least keep the fetched EVP_MD implementation. The thing that is being cleared is the digest context inside the provider. We would have to add a provider function that copies the context data into an existing data but that would require adding support also in third party providers.

It's not impossible to add a copy function in the provider interface, and then have `EVP_MD_CTX_copy_ex` use that copy function *if it's available*, and fall back to the duplication function otherwise.
